info.title: JobRadar API
info.description: All routes require a session cookie unless noted. Mutating routes are origin-checked; expensive routes are rate-limited per user (429 + retry-after). Async routes return 202 {taskId}; watch GET /api/tasks/{id}/stream. Kept in sync with apps/web/app/api/**/route.ts by apps/web/lib/openapi.test.ts.

QueueBusy.description: Background queue full or unavailable (retry-after header)

post.summary: Self sign-up (ALLOW_SIGNUP=true); may require e-mail verification
Complete a password reset with a single-use token; revokes all sessions
Verify e-mail with a single-use token; signs in

get.summary: Job feed: tabs, filters, FTS + semantic search (q), sort. v5: inbox = the caller's evaluations (class = tier id or 'eligible' = default tiers)
One job with the caller's state/application

post.summary: Mark applied / update pipeline status; records what was sent; schedules follow-up

get.summary: Apply kit: files, texts, questions + drafted answers, cover note, ATS notes

post.summary: Score a resume version against the job (async)
Paste a job description when the crawled one is unusable (stored beside it, never over it)

409.description: Job already has a usable description

patch.summary: Accept / reject / edit a suggestion (edits re-validated)

post.summary: Answer a keyword_confirm question (yes + context → confirmed fact)
Upload a resume (multipart: file pdf|docx ≤5 MB, label?) — async parse

get.summary: Resume with current version + version list

patch.summary: Correct the parse (new immutable version) / set master / re-parse

get.summary: Signed link to the original upload

post.summary: Create a version + render: suggestion flow { baseVersionId, jobId, acceptedIds… } or visual editor { baseVersionId, jobId?, content, acceptedSuggestionIds?, note } (tailored with a job, correction without; change log + grounding flags stored)

content.description: Full resume document from the editor (ResumeContentSchema)

get.summary: Redirect to a signed PDF/DOCX link
Serve a signed object (local storage driver); session cookie or extension bearer
Task state (task_lost when the server no longer knows it)
Server-sent task progress (events: open, progress, done, failed)

delete.summary: Erase the account: vectors, files, every row

get.summary: Export all account data as JSON (files as signed links)
Operator health (admin session or x-health-token header)
Prometheus metrics (Authorization: Bearer METRICS_TOKEN or admin)
Active preference document (seeded on first call) + warnings + evaluation count

put.summary: Validate + save a new version; re-evaluates the user's open jobs (async)

post.summary: Dry run: tier counts + examples over recent open jobs (nothing written)

delete.summary: Delete a private preset (system presets are protected)

post.summary: Apply a preset (keeps home/role unless replaceHome) → new version + re-evaluation
Re-save an older version as a new one → re-evaluation

get.summary: Deployment crawl scope (union of users' preferences) + Workday scope suggestions

post.summary: Apply a metro to Workday board search scopes
Create a browser-extension pairing token (cookie session; shown once; ≤5 live per user)

delete.summary: Revoke one ({ id }) or all extension tokens

get.summary: Connection check for the extension (bearer only, CORS for extension origins)
Kit for an application page: matched job (URL → ATS id → none), profile basics, file links, answers, cover note

post.summary: Record an application submitted on the employer site via the extension
